krishi-vidya-nidhi-yojana-odisha.intro_seo: Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana Odisha: tuition and hostel fee support for children of CM-KISAN farmers in medical, engineering, nursing and other courses.
krishi-vidya-nidhi-yojana-odisha._reviewed: 2026-10-21 (CNT-112): the old text said 'up to ₹10,000/year', which no source supports. Official press release (Odisha Information & Public Relations, 28-03-2025): fee support, actual course fee in government institutions, capped per course in private ones (B.Tech ₹60,000, M.Tech ₹66,000, MBA ₹65,000, medical 4-5 yrs ₹37,950, B.Pharma ₹35,000, nursing ₹19,450, 2-yr medical ₹58,000, architecture ₹60,000), for sons/daughters of CM-KISAN beneficiaries. 2026-10-23 (CNT-114): the official Notification of the Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment (No. DAFP-TRG-CMKI-0003-2024/34141, 27-09-2024) confirms the amounts on the page: private-institute yearly amounts run from Rs 5,000 (ITI/ITC) up to Rs 77,895 (B.V.Sc & A.H., OUAT) in Annexure-1; premier government institutes (NIT, IIT, IIM, AIIMS, ICAR, inside and outside Odisha) get the actual fee or at most Rs 1.00 lakh, whichever is less; hostel/mess Rs 1,200 a month (UG, PG, PhD, premier) or Rs 1,000 (diploma, polytechnic, ITI) for 10 months; no private institution outside Odisha is allowed. Portal opens twice a year (July-August, November-December). amount_annual 100000 and amount_min 5000 are therefore correct and left as they are.
krishi-vidya-nidhi-yojana-odisha.deadline_description: The State Scholarship Portal opens twice a year, in July-August and in November-December, for new and renewal applications. The department can change these dates.
